verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports unattended automation through several routes. The Software Agent SDK is a Python library, and the Agent Server exposes it behind an HTTP and WebSocket API. Automations can run on a schedule or from webhooks, there are GitHub workflow guides and CI-failure-fix automations, the pricing page lists API support for scripting, and an auto-approve mode removes the need for interactive confirmation. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented non-interactive/headless CLI flag (the CLI is described as interactive by default), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
